questions.question: What model and token horizon can96H100GPUs support in30days?
questions.gaps: Need GPU SKU/topology, measured useful throughput, qualified trainer/recurrence and serving constraints.

questions.question: How do unique retained tokens, repeated exposures and phase weights determine feasible data demand?
questions.gaps: Need accessible prepared sources and a real retained-token/loader census under the chosen tokenizer.

questions.question: How do we reproduce Marin topic/quality buckets rather than only its search records?
questions.gaps: Need historical compatible embeddings/scorer/calibration/store access, or declare a newly rebuilt taxonomy.

questions.question: What does width-transfer evidence establish about width, depth and expert choices?
questions.gaps: Need matched shape experiments and target-hardware throughput; no optimal depth/expert count is established for our target.

questions.question: How should we tune LR, token batch, decay and schedule before fitting transfer laws?
questions.gaps: Need resolved group conventions and actual proxy grid/repeat/holdout training observations.

questions.question: What experiment grid makes size/horizon laws identifiable and tests extrapolation?
Which evaluation contracts make checkpoints and training stages comparable?
Which Marin long-context experiments were configured/completed and what winner is actually established?
questions.gaps: Need complete paired per-length final capability outcomes; captured8xlaunch alone supplies no winning-skew conclusion.

questions.question: What SFT/RL evidence establishes systems readiness versus broad capability gains?
questions.gaps: Need complete post-training runs and independent capability/guardrail evaluations for the chosen target.

questions.question: How do we add high-quality cyber data without losing attribution or generalization checks?
questions.gaps: Need selected cyber sources, quality/contamination fixtures, held-out tasks/families and matched training controls.
